== Source? ==

What is the source on the 6'-9' length of the quarterstaff? 

Real world quarterstaves are in the vicinity of 5'-6' (real world) in length; given that WoT feet are pretty much equivalent to real world feet, despite a different number of different-sized inches therein, a 6'-9' staff would be inordinately long to be called a "quarterstaff".

-[[User:Sings-With-Spirits|Sings-With-Spirits]] ([[User talk:Sings-With-Spirits|talk]]) 13:38, August 20, 2012 (UTC)

:The WoT measurements should actually be somewhere in the vicinity of 7-10 feet long. The Wikipedia article states that quarterstaves are 6-9 feet long (real-world). The one Mat used against Galad and Gawyn was a foot taller than he was, which would make it eight feet (WoT measurement) long, which is six and two-thirds feet in real-world measurements. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 20:19, August 20, 2012 (UTC)
